services.desc: The Florida Keys are not an easy place to navigate. There are thousands a reefs and tens of thousands of places to bottom out or run aground. On the same token, the Florida Keys offer visitors some of the best fishing they could possibly ask for, if you know where to go. Simply relying on your sonar doesn’t replace the decade’s long experience it takes to become a seasoned fishing captain. Knowing the exact spots where fish are so plentiful they practically jump into the boat and what time of day makes fishing much more enjoyable. quotes.text: Thanks Captain Wayne for a fantastic tarpon trip! We appreciate the extra effort you always make - moonlight departure, pre-scouting the best spots, and catching fresh baits. Would have been a good time even if we hadn't caught the target tarpon but fighting and releasing the big tarpon was fantastic fun! Catching a limit of snapper, enough for many meals, was a major bonus. Can't wait till next year's trip!

Fishing in the Gulf with Captain Wayne was great. It's important to have a connection with your captain and captain Wayne made us feel right at home. He told stories, we told stories and just felt good on our trip. We connected, we caught fish, we had great weather. Great time fishing with Gatling Guide Service and would do it again given the opportunity.

We went out with Capt. Wayne for the day and caught over 50 fish. Around 22 of those were keepers in which we feasted on that night. The rest were either reef sharks, groupers, baitfish or others.I would highly recommend this charter service if you want to catch fish. Capt. Wayne will definitely work making that happen.

All of the Dugger family had the best day fishing ever on his charter boat will be calling you Captain Wayne again believe that!!! Thank you also to Drew the mate he was awesome helping and also teaching us things and so glad that now we know how to fillet the fish . Captain Wayne can’t to see you again!!!

BEST FISHING EXPERIENCE EVER ! MY SONS A FRIEND AND A CLIENT HAD THE BEST TIME ON WAYNE'S BOAT !! ALL DO TO WAYNE'S EXPERIENCE ON A TOUGH FISHING DAY WE CAUGHT THE LIMIT OF ROCKFISH. I CAN'T SAY ENOUGH GOOD THINGS ABOUT WAYNE JUST MET HIM YESTERDAY AND REALLY IMPRESSIVE CAPTAIN!!!
